title: Finance (Fake Money)
subtitle: Test your grasp of Finance (Fake Money) — String 2 tether, Cash-Less Society, Gold Rushes, lattice metals, NESARA bait, Banking Crash, and total uninstallation before the EMF flash.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Finance is not security — it is String 2, a Kevlar-grade tether as fake as religion, built to pickle humanity in toxicity, park life energy in someone else's building, and blind the mind like miners chasing a seam while resets approach. Gold Rushes after the ~1728 orphan Re-set, lattice metals ripped up for idols and sold-back energy, Carnegie libraries of new bullshit, NESARA bait into 15-minute cities and FEMA Camps, and a planned Banking Crash: that is the machine. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Finance (Fake Money) deep-dive. Med-Beds will not fix you and debt forgiveness will not save you — uninstall the obsession so Scare Events and the EMF flash find a stable psyche, not a vaporized identity welded to accounts.

questions.question: What is String 2: Finance in the control matrix?

options.label: A
options.text: A system of exchange that began honestly in Tartaria, and was later corrupted by the Freemasons into a tool for controlling the population.
options.rationale: Med-Beds and debt forgiveness will not save anyone; finance is a parasitic tether, not a liberation tool.

options.label: B
options.text: A natural law of the higher densities, which the parasites copied and distorted to create scarcity in the lower realms of Gateway-10.
options.rationale: Higher densities run as a Cash-Less Society; finance is artificial bondage, not natural cosmic law.

options.label: C
options.text: A primary psychological tether engineered to blind the human population and misdirect consciousness away from spiritual reality.
options.rationale: Finance is String 2 — a fabricated psychological tether that blinds humanity and pulls attention off spiritual reality into the pursuit of wealth.

options.label: D
options.text: A record-keeping method used by the Custodians to track how much Loosh each person produces through their labor.
options.rationale: Finance dictates life trajectories, locks people into survival and servitude, and misdirects consciousness.

questions.hint: Psychological tether — blinds and misdirects from spirit.

questions.question: What are The 3 Strings of Attachment, and how strong are they?

options.label: A
options.text: Gold, silver, and copper — natural metals that free the Lattice Membrane Networks.
options.rationale: Gold and silver were inverted into finance tools; the three strings are psychological tethers, not metals.

options.label: B
options.text: Savings, retirements, and Med-Beds — soft ropes anyone can drop overnight.
options.rationale: The strings are stronger than Kevlar; savings and retirements are finance attachments, not the named triad.

options.label: C
options.text: Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge — engineered psychological anchors stronger than Kevlar to sever.
options.rationale: The triad is Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge. These anchors bind awareness to the artificial simulation and prove stronger than Kevlar to cut.

options.label: D
options.text: NESARA, GESARA, and banking crashes — temporary market cycles.
options.rationale: Those are finance-string weapons and lures; the three strings are Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge.

questions.hint: Religion + Finance + Perceived Knowledge — stronger than Kevlar.

questions.question: How real is money compared with religious control constructs?

options.label: A
options.text: Money becomes real only after NESARA forgives all debt.
options.rationale: NESARA/GESARA is bait for enslavement; it does not make fake money real.

options.label: B
options.text: Money is fully real while religion alone is the only fake string.
options.rationale: Both are engineered strings; finance is as fake as religion.

options.label: C
options.text: Money is pure spiritual technology equal to crystalline homes back home.
options.rationale: Back home is Cash-Less; money is a third-density injection, not true spiritual living tech.

options.label: D
options.text: The concept of money is fundamentally as fake as the religious constructs used to control the masses.
options.rationale: Money is not sacred or natural — it is as fabricated as the religious constructs that control the masses.

questions.hint: Money is as fake as religion — both control constructs.

questions.question: How does the pursuit of financial security, savings, and wealth function on human life?

options.label: A
options.text: As optional decoration that never changes career, family, or daily choices.
options.rationale: It dictates life trajectories and blinds the direction of a whole life.

options.label: B
options.text: As a temporary training wheel that automatically lifts everyone into 9th density.
options.rationale: Finance binds people down; it does not elevate density.

options.label: C
options.text: As artificial gravity that dictates life choices and locks people into a perpetual cycle of survival and servitude.
options.rationale: Chasing financial security acts as artificial gravity — it steers life choices and traps people in endless survival and servitude.

options.label: D
options.text: As the only honest path to equal crystalline homes for all.
options.rationale: Equal crystalline living is Cash-Less Society back home, not wealth-chasing here.

questions.hint: Artificial gravity — survival and servitude loop.

questions.question: What must an individual do with the finance tether to navigate the terminal phase of The Great Spiritual Awakening?

options.label: A

options.rationale: A Med-Bed will not fix you; uninstallation of financial obsession is mandatory personal work.

options.label: B
options.text: Entirely sever attachment to the illusion of finance.
options.rationale: Success in the terminal awakening phase requires completely cutting attachment to the finance illusion — not refining or reforming it.

options.label: C
options.text: Double down on retirement accounts before the banking crash.
options.rationale: Those still tethered to bank accounts and retirements face profound psychological collapse when crashes hit.

options.label: D
options.text: Beg for NESARA/GESARA so debt forgiveness funds the exit.
options.rationale: NESARA/GESARA is psychological bait toward enslavement, not a clean exit tool.

questions.hint: Entirely sever — no half-cut of the illusion.

options.rationale: Wealth becomes obsolete at Scare Events and the EMF flash; clinging does not buy priority homes.

options.label: B
options.text: They keep their material assets through the terminal deconstruction, since the new system honors savings made before the collapse.
options.rationale: Physical wealth, bank accounts, and properties become instantly obsolete under Scare Events and the EMF flash.

options.label: C
options.text: They are made managers of the Cash-Less Society, since their experience with banking is needed to run the new system smoothly.
options.rationale: Cash-Less Society is higher-density equality without currency; clinging to accounts is the opposite of that readiness.

options.label: D
options.text: They suffer profound psychological collapse during the orchestrated banking crashes and global uninstallation protocols.
options.rationale: Remaining welded to banks, retirements, and assets sets up profound psychological collapse when planned banking crashes and uninstallation protocols hit.

questions.hint: Psychological collapse when orchestrated crashes hit.

options.rationale: Gold rushes engineered wealth-chasing; Cash-Less means no currency at all back home.

options.rationale: True higher realms give absolute equality to all beings there; it is not an NPC-only mode.

options.label: D
options.text: The original existence "back home," where all beings share the same standard of living, technology, and crystalline homes without currency.
options.rationale: Cash-Less Society is home truth: identical exceptional living, shared technology, crystalline homes, and zero currency.

questions.hint: Back home — equal living, crystalline homes, no currency.

options.rationale: Gold and silver are meant to stay in the ground as spiritual technology — not mined as currency backing.
